messages:
jamie: OrbitEdge staging failed during marketplace install for HelioHealth. SI says container starts then immediately OOMs + KV errors. https://go/si-runbooks/orbitedge
alex: deploy-bot shows image verify failed earlier — `image.sig` mismatch :warning:
deploy-bot: image-verify job `orbitedge:v2.1.4+market` failed: signature mismatch
taylor-orbit: hey, we pushed artifact yesterday signed with our key. can you share the verify logs?
rahul: quick network check — egress to artifacts.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com allowed? customer has strict egress and an internal proxy. ports 443 outbound needed.
sophie: I saw the crash is `bootstrap` hitting `KVConnectionRefused` in logs. adding snippet:
```
ERROR: KVConnectionRefused host=127.0.0.1:6379
ENV: KV_ENDPOINT=redis://127.0.0.1:6379
```
jamie: SI says they set KV_ENDPOINT to `localhost` for local test but marketplace should inject `internal-redis.cluster:6379` — mismatch during image build.
alex: @taylor-orbit can you re-sign image after swapping env var default to empty? marketplace signature step verifies binary digest + configured metadata.
taylor-orbit: yes we can rebuild & re-sign, but need marketplace key rotation note — signing pipeline currently points to `orbit-key-prod` which expired last week.
ops-bot: created ticket #CON-4821 for signing pipeline rotation
sophie: I can patch a hotfix to bypass default env and make startup tolerate missing KV by deferring startup. small change, no model diff.
jamie: good — can we do a canary on HelioHealth staging only? want to avoid global rollout.
alex: Marketplace policy: canary via `marketplace.tag=staging-helio`. I can request marketplace team do a scoped deploy.
rahul: I'll validate network egress and proxy auth with customer infra. Ping me once SI re-signs image.
taylor-orbit: rebuilding now, ETA ~20m. will post new digest.
jamie: thanks. once new image is signed, @alex pls coordinate scoped deploy and @rahul to approve network. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: orbitedge:v2.1.5+market digest sha256:... (pending signature)
jamie: keeping this thread for handoff; if anyone sees regressions, paste short logs here. :eyes:
ops-bot: scheduled a rolling restart for the staging cluster in 30m to pick up the canary if ready.
sophie: pushed hotfix branch `hotfix/orbit-kv-defer`, demo logs show startup passes.
jamie: perfect — TY everyone.
